title: kalopanax septemlobus subsp. lutchuensis
intro: Kalopanax septemlobus subsp. lutchuensis, commonly known as the Lutchu or Ulmus-like Kalopanax, is a subspecies of the Kalopanax septemlobus plant, a type of flowering plant in the family Araliaceae. It is an evergreen shrub native to the Korean Peninsula. Kalopanax septemlobus subsp. lutchuensis has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions like reducing fever, soothing inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress.
